name: Vilar de Canes (Spain)
description: Quartered white and red with a yellow bend sinister of two ears of wheat over all and a black cross of Montesa in the white quarters.
history: Municipal flag of Vilar de Canes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
